DB-E1.Description:
Create the daily-briefing/ root directory with required base files and AGENT.md index.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Create pyproject.toml with uv-managed dependencies (fastapi>=0.115.0, pydantic>=2.8.0, langgraph>=0.4.0, uvicorn>=0.32.0, structlog>=24.4.0, openai>=1.40.0, httpx>=0.28.0)
- Create .env.example documenting all required env vars (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, LOCAL_LLM_ENABLED, LOCAL_LLM_BASE_URL, DATABASE_URL, POSTGRES_MCP_HOST, CALENDAR_MCP_HOST, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, JWT_SECRET_KEY, APP_ENV, APP_DEBUG)
- Create .gitignore covering node_modules, .env, __pycache__, .next, .venv, .uv
- Create root README.md with project overview and quickstart
- Verify AGENT.md already exists with workflow rules table

EFFORT: S (2 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Infrastructure
DEPENDENCIES: None

TESTING CRITERIA:
- All files present at repo root
- .gitignore covers all generated artifacts
- .env.example lists every variable used across the full stack
- pyproject.toml valid and uv sync succeeds

EDGE CASES:
- Ensure no secrets committed even accidentally
- AGENT.md must remain under 150 lines — index only

Create Dockerfile with multi-stage build for frontend (Next.js) and backend (FastAPI) in a single container.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Stage 1 (frontend-builder): FROM node:22-alpine, WORKDIR /app/frontend, COPY package*.json, RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile, COPY frontend/, RUN npm run build
- Stage 2 (backend-builder): FROM python:3.12-slim, WORKDIR /app, RUN pip install uv, COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock, RUN uv sync --frozen --no-dev
- Stage 3 (production): FROM python:3.12-slim, install nginx and supervisor, COPY --from=frontend-builder, COPY --from=backend-builder, COPY nginx.conf and supervisord.conf, EXPOSE 80
- CMD: /usr/bin/supervisord -c /etc/supervisor/conf.d/supervisord.conf

EFFORT: M (4 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Infrastructure
DEPENDENCIES: DB-001

TESTING CRITERIA:
- docker build completes without errors
- Container starts and health check passes
- Both frontend (/) and backend (/health) accessible

EDGE CASES:
- .next/standalone must include static files copy step
- Use --frozen-lockfile to ensure reproducible builds

Create nginx.conf routing / to Next.js and /api/* to FastAPI.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- events {} block required
- http > server listens on port 80
- location /: proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000; proxy_http_version 1.1; set Upgrade, Connection, Host, X-Real-IP headers
- location /api/: proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8000; proxy_http_version 1.1; set Host, X-Real-IP, X-Forwarded-For headers; proxy_read_timeout 120s
- location /health: proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8000/health
- include /etc/nginx/mime.types

EFFORT: S (2 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Infrastructure
DEPENDENCIES: DB-002

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Static assets and SSR responses served via port 80
- API calls proxied to FastAPI without 502 errors
- /health endpoint reachable and returns 200

EDGE CASES:
- Do NOT use try_files — Next.js standalone is a Node server
- Upgrade/Connection headers required for WebSocket support

Create supervisord.conf to manage nginx, uvicorn, and Next.js processes.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- [supervisord] section: nodaemon=true, logfile=/dev/null, logfile_maxbytes=0
- [program:nginx]: command=/usr/sbin/nginx -g 'daemon off;', priority=10, autorestart=true
- [program:fastapi]: command=uv run uvicorn backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000, directory=/app, priority=20, autorestart=true
- [program:nextjs]: command=node server.js, directory=/app/frontend/.next/standalone, priority=30, autorestart=true
- Environment variables passed via environment= directive

EFFORT: S (2 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Infrastructure
DEPENDENCIES: DB-002, DB-003

TESTING CRITERIA:
- All three processes start and stay running
- Process restarts automatically on crash
- Logs visible via docker logs

EDGE CASES:
- Priority order: nginx first (10), then FastAPI (20), then Next.js (30)
- nodaemon=true required for Docker foreground process

Create docker-compose.yml for local development orchestration.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- services.app: build context=. dockerfile=Dockerfile
- ports: '80:80'
- env_file: .env
- restart: unless-stopped
- healthcheck: test: curl -f http://localhost/health; interval: 30s; timeout: 10s; retries: 3

EFFORT: S (1 hour)
PROJECT AREA: Infrastructure
DEPENDENCIES: DB-004

TESTING CRITERIA:
- docker-compose up starts cleanly
- App accessible at http://localhost
- Health check passes within 90 seconds

EDGE CASES:
- Port 80 may be in use locally — document alternative in README
- .env file must exist before docker-compose up
